integrations.name: Magic UI
integrations.notes: Official MCP and CLI. Client-specific install targets vary; Game Shop should install into the target project/client rather than mirror components.

integrations.name: Kibo UI
integrations.notes: Official component library with MCP support and on-demand CLI installation.

integrations.name: HeroUI
integrations.notes: Official React MCP package @heroui/react-mcp uses stdio; HeroUI Native also exposes an official MCP. CLI supports web projects and Native supports Expo/React Native.

integrations.name: Impeccable
integrations.notes: Agent design skill plus deterministic detector CLI. Strong verifier/repair-loop integration; detector can run as a pre-ship quality gate.

integrations.name: Podium
integrations.auth: Bearer token; live keys use podium_live_ prefix and test keys use podium_test_.
integrations.notes: Verified REST API. Useful for commerce/product infrastructure beyond games.

integrations.name: Skiper UI
integrations.notes: Verified shadcn registry. Pro installs require SKIPER_LICENSE_KEY and licensed registry access; never mirror Pro source.

integrations.name: SmoothUI
integrations.notes: Verified production-ready animated React component and block catalog; no separate public MCP/API promoted in this pass.

integrations.name: Unlumen UI
integrations.notes: Verified UI library with open-source primitives and licensed Pro components. Do not redistribute paid source.

integrations.name: HorizonX
integrations.notes: Premium design/code library. Commercial use is permitted for downloaded assets under membership, but source redistribution/resale is prohibited; no public programmable API verified.

integrations.name: Vengeance UI
integrations.notes: Verified animated component library with documented CLI install flows; exact component commands are selected from its docs rather than hard-coded globally.

integrations.name: Chatterbox TTS
integrations.notes: Official Resemble AI open-source MIT TTS family. Local GPU/runtime integration; use only voices/reference audio the operator has permission to use.

integrations.name: 21st.dev
integrations.auth: API key for CLI/CI; hosted MCP can use interactive sign-in where supported.
integrations.notes: Official MCP/CLI; preserve catalog licensing.

integrations.name: Motion AI Kit
integrations.notes: Installer wires hosted MCP servers and Motion skill. Current hosted flow replaces older local-token configuration.

integrations.name: Mosaic Motion
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 is preferred for MCP; service-account or Bearer Motion API keys are supported. Game Shop uses MOTION_SO_API_KEY as its local env name.
integrations.notes: Official MCP and REST API. REST base is https://api.motion.so/api/motion with POST /sessions and GET /sessions/{job_id}. Paid credits apply.

integrations.name: Spline MCP Server
integrations.notes: Official MCP runs through open Spline desktop app.

integrations.name: Raylight MCP
integrations.auth: OAuth through MCP client; keep Raylight project open.
integrations.notes: Official remote MCP.

integrations.name: Manus API v2
integrations.install: npx skills add https://open.manus.ai/docs --skill manus-api --agent codex --global --yes
integrations.notes: Use API v2 and official skill.

integrations.name: Manus Custom MCP
integrations.notes: Game Shop can itself be connected into Manus.

integrations.name: Rive Web Runtime
integrations.notes: Official JavaScript/WASM runtime; Rive artifacts are first-class Game Shop artifact candidates.

integrations.name: Ludo AI
integrations.auth: Remote HTTP MCP: Authentication: ApiKey <key>; REST base https://api.ludo.ai/api/.
integrations.notes: Async multimodal generation; request_id supports safe retries.

integrations.name: Meshy
integrations.notes: Official MCP and REST API.

integrations.name: fal
integrations.notes: Hosted MCP plus durable queue API.

integrations.name: Replicate
integrations.notes: Official MCP mirrors HTTP API.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs
integrations.notes: Hosted MCP and media APIs.

integrations.name: Scenario
integrations.notes: Verified REST/OpenAPI surface.

integrations.name: Cloudinary
integrations.notes: Artifact lifecycle and delivery layer.

integrations.name: MotionSites AI MCP
integrations.notes: Official remote MCP.

integrations.name: Unison Brain
integrations.notes: Candidate cross-agent project memory.

integrations.name: ContextCore
integrations.notes: Local-first AGPL MCP. Runs a local backend normally at http://127.0.0.1:8000 and a stdio MCP server; appropriate for desktop/local agents, not a Vercel-hosted remote integration.

integrations.name: WanGP / Wan2GP
integrations.notes: Local MCP over stdio or Streamable HTTP.

integrations.name: ShaderGradient
integrations.notes: MIT React renderer.

integrations.name: KokonutUI
integrations.notes: Official @kokonutui shadcn-compatible registry exposed through the official shadcn MCP server.

integrations.name: Bklit UI
integrations.notes: Current Bklit UI is an MIT chart/component registry at @bklit. Configure https://ui.bklit.com/r/{name}.json and consume it through shadcn CLI/MCP; the old Bklit Analytics product is not the integration target.

integrations.name: Cult UI
integrations.notes: Do not mirror Pro content.

integrations.name: Animate UI
integrations.notes: Standard shadcn MCP workflow.

integrations.name: Preline UI MCP
integrations.notes: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP.

integrations.name: daisyUI Blueprint MCP
integrations.auth: Official Blueprint MCP requires license and email; Figma key is optional.
integrations.notes: Official daisyUI Blueprint is the recommended MCP; Context7 and GitMCP are optional third-party alternatives.

integrations.name: shadcn MCP
integrations.notes: Official MCP server bridges AI clients to any shadcn-compatible registry configured in components.json.

integrations.name: OriginKit MCP
integrations.auth: Bearer API key for code editors; OAuth/sign-in supported by compatible chat clients.
integrations.notes: Official hosted MCP plus registry API at https://mcp.originkit.dev/v1. Delivers curated source; it does not generate arbitrary components.

integrations.name: Shaders MCP
integrations.auth: Bearer API key or OAuth in supported connector clients.
integrations.notes: Official Shaders MCP plus JavaScript package and shadcn registry. The same API key can authorize MCP and registry access.

integrations.name: LogoAI Logo API
integrations.notes: Official commercial integration exists, but access is partner-approved rather than self-serve API-key provisioning. Do not mark ready until account approval and implementation docs are supplied.

integrations.name: Headless UI
integrations.notes: Official unstyled accessible component library for React; Vue package is also available.

integrations.name: WebGPU
integrations.notes: Browser platform API rather than a remote service. Route through feature detection and WebGL fallback where needed.

integrations.name: dashersw/liquid-glass-js
integrations.notes: MIT vanilla JavaScript/WebGL library. Repository currently has no formal npm release; consume source deliberately instead of inventing a package install command.

integrations.name: Motion Primitives
integrations.notes: Use core/open components directly; Motion Primitives Pro is licensed source and must not be mirrored or redistributed through Game Shop.

integrations.name: Anime.js
integrations.notes: Local runtime.

integrations.name: Three.js
integrations.notes: Local runtime.

integrations.name: Lenis
integrations.notes: Local runtime.

integrations.name: GSAP
integrations.notes: Respect current licensing.

integrations.name: Spline Code API
integrations.notes: Controls exported Spline scenes.

integrations.name: Jitter
integrations.notes: No public developer API/MCP contract verified yet.

paidGeneration.rule: Any provider operation that can create a billable generation job must call assertPaidGenerationAllowed() immediately before the provider request.
paidGeneration.fallbackRule: Do not automatically resubmit an ambiguous provider generation failure to another vendor; verify whether the first job exists before retrying to avoid duplicate spend.

safety.fallback: pre-submit routing only; no automatic duplicate generation after uncertain provider errors
safety.secrets: environment-only; never returned by orchestration APIs

spendPolicy.rule: Any provider operation that can create a billable generation job must call assertPaidGenerationAllowed() immediately before the provider request.
spendPolicy.fallbackRule: Do not automatically resubmit an ambiguous provider generation failure to another vendor; verify whether the first job exists before retrying to avoid duplicate spend.
